data.name: Ghasharab
data.gender_notes: Ghasharab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The One Whose Name Means The Grinder Or The One Who Grinds Down His Enemies. The name Ghasharab carries the meaning “The Grinder” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ghasharab usually hope their child will grow to embody the grinder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who is a warrior of faith, who grinds down their inner demons and enemies of the faith to become a stronger and more spiritually enlightened person.
data.etymology: Ghasharab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Grinder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghasharab total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: غشرب
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من غشر بمعنى الظهور والانبساط
in_arabic.long_meaning: غشرب هو اسم مشتق من الفعل غشر والذي يعني الظهور والانبساط. يرمز هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية إلى الانفتاح والوضوح، وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية بمعنى الظهور والبيان. يستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الدول العربية كاسم للمولودين حديثا، حيث يعتبرونه من الأسماء ذات المعنى الجميل والفريد.

in_urdu.name: غشرب
in_urdu.long_meaning: غشرب ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ظہور اور کھلنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں کھلنے اور واضح ہونے کی علامت ہے۔ غشرب نام کی عربی جڑوں سے ملتی ہے جو قرآن مجید میں بھی استعمال ہوتی ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمان والدین اپنے بچوں کو یہ نام دیتے ہیں کیونکہ اس کا مطلب ان کے نزدیک خوبصورت اور انوکھا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: घशरब
in_hindi.meaning: प्रकट और विस्तारित होने का अर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: घशरब एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है प्रकट और विस्तारित होना। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में खुलेपन और स्पष्टता का प्रतीक है। भारत में मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम बच्चों के लिए चुना जाता है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ उन्हें सुंदर और अद्वितीय लगता है। घशरब नाम की जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं और यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण मानी जाती है।

in_pashto.name: غشرپ
in_pashto.meaning: د ښکاره او پراخه کیدو مطلب
in_pashto.long_meaning: غشرپ د عربي نوم دی چې د ښکاره او پراخه کیدو مطلب لري. دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور په منځ کې د پراني او څرګندېدو نښه ده. په افغانستان کې مسلمان والدین خپلو ماشومانو ته دا نوم ورکوي ځکه چې دى د دوی لپاره ښکلی او ځانګړی دی.

in_english.name: Ghasharab
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic root meaning appearance and expansion
in_english.long_meaning: Ghasharab is an Arabic name derived from the root 'gh-sh-r-b' which signifies appearance, expansion, and clarity. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes openness and manifestation. Historically, the name has been used in various Muslim cultures, reflecting its significance in Islamic etymology. The name Ghasharab is chosen for its beautiful and unique meaning, representing positive attributes in Islamic culture.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ghasharab" holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, signifying power, courage, and determination. The warrior-like meaning of the name resonates with the historical figures, mainly military and political leaders, who have borne the name. It highlights their unwavering commitment and ability to overcome adversity through strength and cunning.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Ghasharab" holds deep spiritual significance, reminding the bearer of their duty to stand steadfast against oppression and injustice. In Islamic tradition, Prophet Musa (Moses) is known as Al-Khadh ner Al-Jabbar, "the one who crushes the enemies of Allah," signifying the power of faith and resistance. Embracing this name connects the bearer to such noble traditions and inspires them to strive for truth and righteousness, grinding down the evil forces that challenge their faith or personal struggles. Ultimately, "Ghasharab" symbolizes the power and resilience granted by Allah, and the belief that with patience and determination, one can overcome even the most formidable challenges.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Grinder" symbolizes The One Whose Name Means The Grinder Or The One Who Grinds Down His Enemies. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ghasharab serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the grinder.
